entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.9212 of 2024
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') by the petitioner/accusedseeking to quash proceeding against him in C.C.No.520 of 2023 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate at Sirpur, Kumuaram Bheem Asifabad District, for the offences punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 7(a) of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate at Sirpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri K. Venumadhav, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Arun Kumar Doddla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is falsely implicated in the case.

He further submitted that there is no such allegation that the petitioner purchased the alleged PDS rice from any of either Mandal Level Stock Point or Fair Price Shop dealer or from any of the card holder is diverted into the market and stored in the rice mill.
Hence, he prayed this Court to allow the Criminal Petition by quashing the proceedings against the petitioner.

4. As seen from the record, the District Civil Supply Officer, Kumuram Bheem, Asifabad has conducted a detailed enquiry and represented that no evidence was found about clandestine business with PDS rice and no evidence was found that the petitioner purchased the PDS rice.
Further, the petitioner also submitted relevant stock records stating that the rice pertains to the rejected ACKs of CMR for the season Kharif 2022-23 and also submitted relevant stock records.
On 04.09.2023, the CSDTs also confirmed that the seized stocks pertain to the rejected ACKs of CMR for the season Kharif 2022-23.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that continuation of proceedings against the petitioner/accused, who is owner of the rice mill, is nothing but abuse of process of law.

5. Accordingly,this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner/accusedin C.C.No.520 of 2023 on the file ofJudicial First Class Magistrate at Sirpur, Kumuaram Bheem Asifabad District, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: ofJudicial First Class Magistrate at Sirpur, Kumuaram Bheem Asifabad District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.
